description:
A workout remembered the next morning lands on the wrong calendar day, and nothing can move it. Accept a performedAt override on POST /api/sessions.

The trap is find-or-create: todaySessionForDay and todayFreeformSession both test isToday(performedAt), so a naive override returns today's session instead of creating the back-dated one. Both must key on the target calendar day. Rotation reads the latest session by performedAt, so back-dating can also reorder what "next up" means.
title: Back-date a session
